Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter

Record Class SecuritySnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter.SecuritySnapshot
Record Components:
selinux - the SELinux enforcement mode
firewall - the firewall running state
scannerAvailable - whether a ClamAV scanner was found on the PATH
scanner - the scanner name (empty when none is available)
version - the ClamAV engine / database version
tor - the private (Tor) mode state (TorPrivateMode.State)
vpnConnected - whether a VPN tunnel is currently up
vpnKillSwitch - whether the connected tunnel's kill switch is armed
public record SecuritySnapshot(SecurityProbe.SelinuxMode selinux, SecurityProbe.FirewallState firewall, boolean scannerAvailable, String scanner, VersionInfo version, org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.TorPrivateMode.State tor, boolean vpnConnected, boolean vpnKillSwitch) extends Record
The host's aggregated security posture shown on the Security Overview tab: the SELinux mode, the firewall state, whether an antivirus scanner is installed (and which one), the ClamAV engine / database version, the private (Tor) mode state and whether a VPN tunnel is up (with its kill switch armed). The panel assembles one of these from the SecurityProbe and AntivirusBackend parser results plus the in-memory TorPrivateMode.state() and a read-only VPN check after a refresh; concerns() turns the host rows into the plain-language advice list, while SecurityScore and HardeningRules consume the whole snapshot to derive the grade and the ordered recommendations.

    • SecuritySnapshot

      public SecuritySnapshot(SecurityProbe.SelinuxMode selinux, SecurityProbe.FirewallState firewall, boolean scannerAvailable, String scanner, VersionInfo version)
      Backward-compatible host-only form: no anonymity or tunnel layer is asserted, so tor reads TorPrivateMode.State.OFF and the VPN is down. Callers and tests that only probe SELinux / firewall / antivirus keep compiling against this constructor.
      Parameters:
      selinux - the SELinux enforcement mode
      firewall - the firewall running state
      scannerAvailable - whether a ClamAV scanner was found on the PATH
      scanner - the scanner name (empty when none is available)
      version - the ClamAV engine / database version

      public List<String> concerns()
      The plain-language concerns implied by this posture, worst first. An empty list means nothing actionable was detected (SELinux enforcing, firewall running, a scanner installed).
